evals.prompt: The migration is verified. Archive the old project.
evals.expected_output: Sets the source project status to the agreed value, noting there is no archive status.
expectations: States Multica has no archived status
Uses cancelled or paused as agreed and not completed by default
Does not delete issues or the project
Mentions it is reversible via multica project status

evals.prompt: Point my daemon at the new server.
evals.expected_output: Logs in with a separate profile, starts the daemon, confirms the runtime online, never kills multica by name.
expectations: Confirms the runtime is online on the target
Does not terminate multica by executable name
Reminds the user to revoke the pasted token
